title: Email Exporter Configuration
description: SMTP server, sender, and authentication used to send the messages.

smtp.title: SMTP
smtp.description: Connection and sender settings for the SMTP server.

host.title: Host
host.description: Hostname of the SMTP server (e.g. smtp.example.com). Required to deploy.

port.title: Port
port.description: 587 for STARTTLS, 25 for an unauthenticated relay

use_tls.title: Use STARTTLS
use_tls.description: Upgrade the connection with STARTTLS; required for password auth

from_address.title: From Address
from_address.description: Sender address; must be a valid email address. A display name is reduced to the bare address. Required to deploy.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Wire credentials to a secret on deployment.

method.title: Method
method.description: none for an unauthenticated relay; username_password requires STARTTLS

method.title: Method
method.description: none for an unauthenticated relay; username_password requires STARTTLS

password.title: Password
password.description: SMTP AUTH password; wire this to a secret
